paraphrase: In the age of the final Dharma many have dry wisdom; to test true and false there are three leaks: the leak of view (the function does not leave its position and falls into a sea of poison), the leak of feeling (stuck in likes and dislikes, one-sided view), the leak of words (seeking the wondrous and losing the tenet).

paraphrase: The five ranks of lord and minister in verse: the apparent within the real (midnight before the moon shines — meeting without recognising); the real within the apparent (an old woman who overslept meets an ancient mirror); coming from within the real (a road out of nothingness, beyond the dust); arriving within both (crossed swords, a lotus in fire); arrived within both (not falling into being or non-being, returning to sit among the coals).
